name: clark-commons
description: Civic coordination and budget-transparency platform for Clark County, Arkansas. Free, open, anti-extractive.

dependencyNotes._policy: SECURITY.md §11: every package justified here; prefer stdlib and boring choices.
dependencyNotes.pdf-parse: corpus ingestion — text and scan-image extraction from county PDFs
dependencyNotes.pngjs: pure-JS PNG decode for the 1bpp de-shear fix (pipeline/lib-ocr.js)
dependencyNotes.qrcode: pure-JS QR SVG generation for shareable question links; no native deps, no network
dependencyNotes.tesseract.js: WASM OCR for scanned minutes and ordinances; no system install
